limits: Ordinary optical wall occlusion is not reproduced: the SDK does not disclose per-source affected_tiles; transparent sprite quads do not cast equivalent shadows. Backend visibility remains authoritative.
Private noncontrolled inventory and standalone spell/contribution emitters are not disclosed as light sources and are not inferred from tile brightness.
Current modular runtime illumination uses flat billboard receivers; the newly supplied one-outfit experimental depth/normal delivery is available but not adopted.
Source lift, neutral colour and smooth radial radiance gains are explicit optical conventions; emitter sockets/heights/hues/intensity are not authored or disclosed.
The shader loops disclosed source count per fragment; 25-source correctness is tested, not large-map lighting performance.
Historical live screenshot timings include startup and capture waits; current staged profiling is linked in render_repair_validation.json and is not a large-map benchmark.
No generic-caster portrait image exists in the authored UI registry; missing portrait is reported and omitted.

The original chest source is byte-identical to Unity; native Compatibility colour conversion produces a measured raw Canvas/Spatial difference up to5/255, within1/255 after the documented native transfer.
